name: follows a formatting instruction the training data never contained
input: In one sentence, with no headings, labels or line breaks: what does ImagePullBackOff mean?
notes: Tuning teaches a default, not a floor. This case asks for a shape the training set never held, so an answer in the training form is the tuned model answering from its weights instead of from the prompt.

assertions.why: the training form's opening label; emitting it against an explicit instruction not to means the form has displaced the instruction
the same test at the other end of the form — an overfitted model closes with the label whatever it was asked for
one line, as asked; the training form spans several, so an internal line break is the form leaking back in
